curriculum.title: Jesus, Gospel, and Salvation: Family Prayer and Service Flex

core.big_idea: A flexible unit may reinforce the cycle through a family prayer, service, or generosity practice.

passages.reading_note: Read in context. Flex placeholders must be replaced by an approved passage before publication.

core.metanarrative_position: Optional prayer, service, and generosity practicum that distinguishes direct commands from prudential implementation.

claims.statement: This optional Cycle 2 slot may be used for family prayer, service, or generosity practice without altering the canonical core.
claims.interpretive_hinge: This is a curriculum scheduling conclusion from the canonical matrix, not a verse commanding this lesson architecture.
claims.prohibited_overstatement: Do not present this scheduling structure as a direct biblical command.

claims.statement: If the slot is used for biblical teaching, the editor-selected passage must govern the claims and application.
evidence_refs: D001 Scripture as final doctrinal authority
claims.interpretive_hinge: The project’s authority rule requires the selected biblical text to govern the lesson rather than the calendar need or local agenda.
claims.prohibited_overstatement: Do not publish the flex lesson until the passage and claims have been reviewed.

core.interpretation_skill: Observe text; reconstruct context; account for genre; distinguish text, synthesis, inference, and application

learning.foundation_objective: A flexible unit may reinforce the cycle through a family prayer, service, or generosity practice.
learning.extension_objective: Support the big idea with evidence, label the reasoning used, and identify one faithful response without overstating the text.
know: The lesson belongs to Jesus, Gospel, and Salvation Cycle 2.

understand: Meaning depends on immediate context, genre, and the evidence actually available.

become: A learner who reads Scripture carefully and responds with trust, wisdom, worship, service, courage, and love.

Student can support the big idea with the appropriate evidence class.

activities.title: Prayer Service and Generosity Planner
steps: Read the selected evidence and record direct observations.
Place observations, interpretations, framework choices, or prudential applications into the resource categories.
Discuss which conclusions require more than direct textual wording.
Write one careful response that follows from the evidence.
activities.learning_link: Makes the lesson’s evidence classification and formation aim visible.
activities.low_resource_alternative: Draw the categories on blank paper or complete the exercise verbally.

activities.title: Evidence Class Check
steps: Read several statements connected to the lesson.
Classify each as text observation, synthesis, framework choice, prudential judgment, or application.
Return to the evidence and justify each classification.
activities.low_resource_alternative: Use verbal responses instead of written cards.

closing.prayer_prompt: Thank God for what the selected passage reveals and ask for wisdom to respond faithfully.
closing.take_home_line: A flexible unit may reinforce the cycle through a family prayer, service, or generosity practice.

family.title: Jesus, Gospel, and Salvation: Family Prayer and Service Flex
family.parent_intro: Start with the selected passage. Do not use this flex template until the editor has selected and reviewed the passage.

flow.instructions: Connect this lesson to something already learned in Cycle 2.
Read the editor-selected approved passage and name direct observations.
Restate the big idea in your own words: A flexible unit may reinforce the cycle through a family prayer, service, or generosity practice.
Use the Prayer Service and Generosity Planner verbally, on paper, or with the provided worksheet.
Name one careful response that follows from the evidence without claiming more than the text supports.

interactive.title: Prayer Service and Generosity Planner

family.weekly_action: Revisit one Cycle 2 passage and explain what it says, what it means, and one faithful response.

non_reader_support: Read the passage aloud and use icons, sequence cards, oral choices, or a scribe where helpful.

do_not_ask: Do not require disclosure of trauma, family finances, giving amounts, grief, or private spiritual decisions.
Do not pressure a child or young person toward baptism, public prayer, giving, or another public response.
safeguarding.teacher_response: Answer from the selected evidence, acknowledge uncertainty where needed, and route personal or safety concerns to appropriate adults.
